caseName: COULTER Et Al. v. ANTHONY Et Al.
caseNameFull: Murray Whitfield Coulter and George Prothro Coulter v. Garland Anthony, Fay Furlow, James Abbott
attorneys: U. A. Gentry for appellants., J. E. Gaughan for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
